blocks.content: To loop through an array, you must know the positions of the first and last elements.

items: The first element is always at index 0.
The last element's index depends on the array's size.

blocks.content: To determine an array's size, you can use the length property.
Here, the scores array contains five elements. Thus, scores.length returns 5.
Now, let's see how you can access the last element.
